units.source_text: 只有我感到体内充满了力量。

en.t: Only I felt my body filled with strength.
At least, that was what I thought.

units.source_text: 老师翻开讲义，环视了众人一圈。

en.t: The teacher opened his lecture notes and looked around at everyone.

units.source_text: 我的视线追着老师的视线。

en.t: My eyes followed the teacher's gaze.

units.source_text: 因为我要让他瞧瞧，我是决不会垂下眼帘的。

en.t: Because I wanted to show him that I would never lower my eyes.

units.source_text: 但是，老师那双眼圈满是松弛的皱纹的眼睛，没有露出任何感兴趣的神采，

en.t: But the teacher's eyes, ringed with loose wrinkles, showed no trace of interest,

units.source_text: 他将视线从我身上移问我贴邻的人的脸上。

en.t: and he shifted his gaze from me to the face of the person sitting right next to me.
